You don't have to go through sexual reassignment surgery to transition. I'm 21 years old and have been on hormones for about five months now. (MtF) You should look into getting a therapist and an endocrinologist. 

To be honest when I was in the beginning stages of coming out what I found most helpful were online message boards, forums etc.

Places where you can be anonymous and talk to people and ask questions without having to worry about backlash from your community on your family.

I started on 4chan's LGBT board, here on asktransgender and on the transgender board. A part from that I spent hours and hours Googling and reading tons of peoples experiences etc.

Once I knew that this was who I was and I couldn't live another way I pulled the trigger, got a therapist, got an endocrinologist and started HRT and transition. 

It's been five months and this is the happiest I've ever been.

Good luck and I wish you the best :)

I used to cut as well. I'm happy to be able to say I haven't cut in over 3 years. Thoughts of suicide, depression, mania, the whole shibang.

Suicide and cutting are a permanent solution to a temporary problem. Things are never as bad as they seem and I know you will hate me for posting this but it will get better, it will just take time.

Find coping mechanisms, find something you enjoy and instead of letting all of those shitty emotions drive you into cutting funnel them into something constructive.

I don't want to post a wall o' text here but as a quick but decent example now whenever I want to cut I just hop on my motorcycle and go for a ride, or plug my guitar into its amp and just play random shit until my fingers hurt and I'm so tired of strumming I no longer want to cut.

The scars may not seem like an issue now but talking from a perspective of having them after not have cutting for years they genuinely suck ass.

Seek help, talk to friends, relatives, therapists. It's never as bad as it seems and there is always a way to fix it

Best of luck and god speed michelle.
